impact.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game VFX animation sprite atlas for a friendly dark-dungeon tower defense game. Create a WIDE LANDSCAPE 1536 by 1024 transparent image, exactly SIX equal columns and FOUR equal rows, 24 square cells in a perfectly regular edge-to-edge grid, each cell 256 by 256. Do not print any grid lines, labels, text, backgrounds, shadows or checkerboard. Every effect is centered inside its own square cell with 20 percent transparent padding, NEVER crossing a cell boundary. Each ROW is ONE consistent six-frame impact animation read left to right: frame 1 small initial spark, frame 2 sudden expanding burst, frame 3 broad peak burst, frame 4 fragmented outward expansion, frame 5 fading shards, frame 6 faint dissipating motes. ROW 1: warm amber cannon impact, white-yellow core, orange sparks and a few charcoal rock chips, no full fireball. ROW 2: ice impact, crisp cyan-white six-point crystal burst, frosty shards and blue mist. ROW 3: violet lightning impact, bright lavender center and chunky branching electric arcs expanding then dissipating. ROW 4: golden-green precision projectile impact, sharp gold starburst, mint green crescent and narrow flying splinters. Style: chunky hand-painted 2D cartoon game VFX, bold readable silhouettes, clean dark outlines around solid shards, glowing highlights bounded within effect, original child-friendly fantasy, consistent top-down three-quarter view, not pixel art, not realistic, no scary faces, no UI, no monsters, no weapons. Preserve true transparent alpha everywhere outside individual effect shapes; no colored backdrop. Animated coherent progression, professionally usable at 50 to 110 game pixels.

utility.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game VFX and particle sprite atlas, matching chunky hand-painted cartoon dark-dungeon tower defense art. Create a WIDE LANDSCAPE 1536 by 1024 image with genuine transparent alpha. EXACT SIX columns and FOUR rows, 24 equal 256-square cells, completely regular grid. No drawn grid, separators, text, labels, frame borders, backgrounds or checkerboard. Keep all artwork centered in its cell with generous transparent padding; no effect extends across cells. ROW 1 contains six sequential MUZZLE FLASH frames, aimed straight UP in every frame: tiny orange spark, sudden narrow white-yellow jet, peak orange star-shaped cone, shrinking plume, ember trail, faint wisps. Flashes centered at the same point, no weapon or base. ROW 2 contains six sequential STONE MONSTER DEFEAT frames: small dusty burst, expanding grey-brown cloud with angular stone pieces, peak radial stone fragmentation, outward separated pebbles and gold sparks, fading dust, tiny dissipating dust flecks. No intact monster or creature, no gore. ROW 3 contains six sequential SHOCKWAVE frames: small warm white-gold ring, medium ring, broad gold ring, wider broken ring, thin fading arc ring, barely visible motes. Circular rings in top-down view, center transparent. ROW 4 contains six SEPARATE individual particle assets, not an animation: column1 compact iron cannonball with a little amber rim light; column2 short pointed cyan ice shard aimed UP; column3 compact purple lightning orb with two small arc flickers; column4 long slim gold and green arrow projectile aimed UP; column5 one angular grey stone fragment; column6 one small warm golden spark. Objects fully contained and easily readable at 12 to 30 pixels. Bold clean silhouettes, bounded luminous accents, minimal detail, original friendly fantasy. Outside the shapes the canvas must be actually transparent, no ambient color wash and no shadows.
